result:
Round 289 passes. Every acceptance row ran, all browser rows at 1440×900 and 1280×720, and I found no bugs, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. I edited no app source, and A's tree was unchanged at the end of my checks.

**What I confirmed:**
- **Names and headings:** the demo library is English: `Night Pulse`, `Full mix`, `Pulse`, `Bass`, `Pad`, `Melody`. No Georgian is left in the page text or in tooltips/accessible labels (before: 8 text lines and 10 attributes). The list shows exactly two collection headings in the right order, with the planned heights, and the per-card collection line is gone. Visible library items drop from 14 to 11.
- **Keyboard:** Arrow keys walk all 9 sounds down and back. Focus never lands on a heading, the focus ring stays visible, and every step stays inside the list.
- **Filtered views and search:** filtering by collection or folder, and searching `zzz`, `night`, `bass` and `synthetic`, all behave as specified. Headings appear only when the results span two collections.
- **Add, play and export:**
  - Adding Bass gives the exact status sentence, Undo text, clip name and footer line.
  - The playhead moves, and real audio comes out while playing and stops at Stop.
  - The exported WAV is 16.000 s, 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo, with real signal, and bit-identical to the export from the baseline commit.
  - Dragging a sound from inside a group onto a lane still adds it.
- **Sign-in protection is not bypassed:** with no credentials, `/studio-lab` opens as the demo. The purchased Studio page shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. The token API returns 401 with no token and 403 with a fake one.
  - The 403 needs the loop's mock backend, which wasn't running at the start; without it the fake token gets a 500, still with no token handed out. I started the mock and stopped it again afterwards.
- **Code and tests:**
  - The baseline claims match.
  - Only the six allowed files changed, and no existing test assertion was removed.
  - Typecheck passes and the 15 covering test files pass (255 tests).
  - My own five mutants each break exactly the tests they should.
  - Doc 216 is correct.

The full test suite, build, lint, `verify` and the e2e smoke test are the gate's job, so I did not claim them. One thing could not run here: how a purchased product's library looks, because there is no backend in the cloud. It is listed as blocked; a unit test covers it.

**Notes for B (not bugs):**
- When a search from "All" matches only one collection (for example "bass"), the card shows just "Bass" with no heading. Nothing visible says which collection it belongs to; the only cues are the hover tooltip, the screen-reader description and the preview panel. That is what the task specified, but it falls short of the round's promise that you can always see the collection. It could go to Saba alongside the open name questions.
- `b-round-288/sketch.patch`, which the task says was kept, does not exist; A noticed this too.
- A left out the `Fragment` import the task listed, because an unused import fails lint. I accepted that.
- A's code reviewer raised three Low notes for B to triage; I saw no browser symptom of any of them.

**Ableton:** the round meets the CZABA requirement. The group heading is a deliberate difference listed in the task. I did not claim that Live shows search results the same way: that is unconfirmed until Saba's measurement in Live.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop:

- c-round-289.json
- c-round-289/
